description:
[Deterministic Italian electric & gas bill decomposition. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Algorithmic breakdown of electricity and natural gas bills under ARERA regulatory texts (TIT/TIF), separating energy raw commodity (PUN/PSV), commercialization PCV, network transport and meter management, general system charges (ASOS/ARIM), and excise/VAT taxes.
Usage: Use this tool to audit corporate and domestic utility invoices, verify regulated tariff components, and check energy-intensive exemptions.
Returns: JSON object with { costDecompositionEur: object, unitCostAverages: object, costSharePercentages: object, auditVerdict: object }.

contractedPowerKw.description: Contracted power in kW (for electricity, e.g. 3, 15, 30)

energyRawPriceEurPerUnit.description: Specific energy wholesale or contracted rate in EUR/unit

isEnergyIntensiveCompany.description: Whether enterprise is registered as energy-intensive (energivoro) for ASOS discount

name: arera_bill_decomposer
